values.note: Booking page: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.' DNR: 'Advance reservations are encouraged, but walk-ins are welcome.' Campsite check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. A 2026-2027 water and wastewater project closes campsites at various times; the Hemlock Loop has been eliminated. Winter campsites and driveways are not plowed.

booking.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/new-germany-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380118 (Booking Window) + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/NewGermany/Cabins-and-Campsites.aspx ('Advance reservations are encouraged, but walk-ins are welcome.'; check-in/out; NOTICE; WINTER ALERT) + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/newgermany.aspx (CLOSURE NOTICE), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The booking site lists 38 campsites in the White Oak and Pines loops (plus cabins, two glamping sites and the Alpine Lodge shelter). Of the 28 marked for RVs/trailers, 24 list a 20-ft max vehicle length and four 30 ft, one of them a pull-through; the tent-only sites list longer parking. DNR: 'Some sites can accommodate motorhomes'.

sites.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/new-germany-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380118 (site list and per-site details: Looking For Category, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/NewGermany/Cabins-and-Campsites.aspx, read 2026-10-21

values.note: The White Oak Loop's bathhouse is heated for year-round use.

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/NewGermany/Cabins-and-Campsites.aspx ('A central bathhouse provides restrooms and hot showers, and purified water is available at several locations.'; 'An RV dump station is also available.'; 'The White Oak Loop is open year-round with a heated bathhouse.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/new-germany-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380118 (Services and Amenities: Park Store), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's New Germany pages and the booking site: 365-day window closing 1 day before arrival, walk-ins welcome; 38 campsites, RV sites to 30 ft (most listed 20 ft) with a pull-through; showers, purified water, dump, store. Fees (manual) match the booking table. Electric not written: see flag. Season left (manual) but its note is wrong: see flag. Weekend/holiday minimums not stated for this park (left inherited). Note kept.
flags: Season (manual, not overwritten): season.note says 'Pines and White Oak loops year-round', but DNR's camping page says 'The White Oak Loop is open year-round with a heated bathhouse. The Pines Loop is open April 1 - October 31.' and the booking site's 2026/2027 reservable dates agree (Pines Loop April 1 - October 31) (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/NewGermany/Cabins-and-Campsites.aspx).

Electric: DNR says 'only one site offers electric hook-ups (campsite #34)', and the booking site lists site 034 (White Oak Loop, 50 amp) with 'Campground Host Site: Y'. A lone electric site that is the host's may not be public, so hookups.electric was not written; the entry's fees.surcharges electric +$9 (manual) rests on that one site.
Phone missing: the entry's phone is empty; DNR lists 'Contact: 301-895-5453' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/newgermany.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/NewGermany/Cabins-and-Campsites.aspx.
Fit: 24 of the 28 RV-category campsites list a 20-ft max vehicle length; four list 30 ft (AWH's note says most site lengths are 40-50 ft).
